verdict_direction: predicted_positive: a fast change of command is a rollout that recovers
note: the interval is wide and the ladder thin because of two properties of this release rather than of the behaviour: it truncates rollouts at 15 commanded steps, so the length the design controls for barely varies, and 97.6% of the cell changes its command after a failure, so the comparison is a minority of non-changers against everyone else. Both counts are printed with the estimate (deviations W9-D05 and W9-D06)
the frozen claim is a decay toward zero across lags, so the verdict is the monotonicity of the fitted advantages; each lag is its own coefficient, never pooled
